def fn(x):
    import string
    # QWERTY order that will replace the normal alphabet
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    # create lower‑case mapping a->q, b->w, …
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(string.ascii_lowercase, qwerty)}
    # same mapping for upper‑case letters
    upper_map = {a.upper(): q.upper() for a, q in lower_map.items()}
    # combine both dictionaries
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # translate each character, leaving others untouched
    return ''.join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)
```
